integrity: Direct exact symbolic proof and 19 concrete exact-matrix checks; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
limitations: Real centerless almost-abelian Lie algebras with invertible action only; no claim for singular action or for classification of all automorphisms. Priority under the older theory of real reversible linear systems remains a stated risk.
title: Real almost-abelian Lie algebras: fixed-point-free automorphisms and the imaginary-Jordan parity obstruction
